details: Increasing tensions between the United States and Iran are creating a broader risk-off atmosphere in global markets. Further military strikes and unsuccessful diplomatic efforts have dimmed prospects for an immediate ceasefire. Iran's alleged rejection of a peace proposal, reportedly passed through the Iraqi prime minister, raises alarms for further military build-up. This geopolitical uncertainty has contributed to a downturn in the cryptocurrency market, with Bitcoin slipping below $65,000, and institutional demand weakening due to spot Bitcoin ETF outflows. Rising oil prices, surpassing $101 per barrel, also stoke inflation fears and tighten financial conditions, impacting risk-sensitive assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Escalating US-Iran Tensions Fuel Risk-Off Sentiment in Crypto Markets

details: The European Union has adopted its 21st package of restrictive measures against Russia, significantly expanding sanctions on its financial and banking sector, as well as crypto operators. As part of this package, cryptocurrency exchange HTX (formerly Huobi) was sanctioned for allegedly aiding Russian sanctions evasion. The EU stated that HTX was among 18 companies providing crypto services that helped Russians circumvent sanctions. This move intensifies pressure on Russia's financial shadow economy and highlights increasing global scrutiny on crypto platforms' compliance with international sanctions.
sourceName: Reuters (reported via Global Banking & Finance Review)
title: EU Sanctions Crypto Exchange HTX Amidst New Russia Finance Crackdown

details: The U.S. CLARITY Act, a key piece of legislation intended to define the market structure for digital assets, remains stuck in an "ethical stalemate." A new draft of the bill presented by Senate Republicans on July 22 has ignited fresh disputes between Republicans and Democrats. The core disagreement lies in whether enforcement of ethical norms should be centralized under the U.S. Department of Justice (Republican position) or distributed among state attorneys general (Democratic position). This legislative deadlock prolongs regulatory uncertainty for the cryptocurrency market, which analysts believe is contributing to major banks lowering their price targets and a cautious stance from institutional investors.
sourceName: CoinGape (also mentioned by Cryptocurrency News for July 24, 2026)
title: US CLARITY Act Stalled, Prolonging Regulatory Uncertainty for Crypto
